title: Free Love Test
body: Not sure where your relationship is going? Take a soft, private love test and get a clearer signal before you overthink the next message.

title: Daily Love Oracle
body: Today's love energy may be quieter than you expect. Before you chase clarity from someone else, check what your own heart is trying to tell you.

title: Ask One Private Love Question
body: One message. One silence. One confusing signal. If you could ask the universe one private love question today, what would it be?

title: Breakup Recovery Reading
body: If you are stuck between letting go and waiting, write down the one question you are afraid to ask. A focused love reading can help you reflect before you act.

title: Soulmate Signal
body: Sometimes the strongest soulmate signal is not intensity, but peace. Check your current connection with a short love reflection before making the next move.
